basis: The maintainer requested a local port of the two 1.2.0 Swift helpers to macOS JavaScript for Automation after SkillHub rejected the Swift file extension.
local_changes: Use one bundled JavaScript helper for the existing website listing and explicit clipboard copy operations.
Keep listing queries limited to attributes and bind the password lookup to one persistent Keychain item reference.
Write the exact UTF-8 data to the current Mac's clipboard only on the copy path.
verification: Synthetic items in isolated Keychains covered metadata-only queries, unique and ambiguous matches, and exact UTF-8 clipboard data. The 1.2.1 package passed SkillHub preflight using reskills 4.12.1.
source_review: Apple documentation was consulted for the JavaScript bridge and native Keychain and clipboard API behavior. No external code or workflow text is distributed in the Skill.
